record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.original_question: Does the integrable N = 2 super KdV equation SKdV_1 admit a bihamiltonian structure, despite being one of the rare classical integrable systems not known to be bihamiltonian, unlike the SKdV_{-2} and SKdV_4 cases whose first and second Hamiltonian operators are known?

evidence.quote: The SKdV−2,4 equations are both bihamiltonian ... In that respect, the SKdV1 stands as one of the rare example of classical integrable system which is not (known to be) bihamiltonian. OP-5: Is SKdV1 bihamiltonian?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the integrable N=2 supersymmetric KdV equations in N=2 superspace, parametrized by a parameter α (often denoted a) and given, for a chiral/antichiral N=2 superfield Φ, by
   Φ_t = -Φ_{xxx} + 3(Φ D̄ D Φ)_x + ((α-1)/2)(D̄ D (Φ^2))_x + 3 α Φ^2 Φ_x,
where D, D̄ are the standard N=2 supercovariant derivatives. The integrable cases occur at α ∈ {-2, 1, 4}; denote the corresponding hierarchies SKdV_{-2}, SKdV_1, SKdV_4. For α = -2 and α = 4 the hierarchies are known to admit a bi-Hamiltonian structure, i.e. there exist two compatible Hamiltonian operators P_1, P_2 and Hamiltonian functionals H_1, H_2 such that the flow can be written as Φ_t = P_1 δH_1/δΦ = P_2 δH_2/δΦ.

Problem: Determine whether the SKdV_1 hierarchy (the α = 1 case of the integrable N=2 super KdV equations) admits a bi-Hamiltonian structure. Equivalently, exhibit two compatible Hamiltonian operators (and corresponding Hamiltonians) generating the SKdV_1 flow, or else prove no such pair exists.
artifact.status_search_result: A bi-Hamiltonian structure for the N=2 α=1 supersymmetric KdV hierarchy was constructed explicitly by Kersten, Krasil'shchik and Verbovetsky (published 2002), along with a recursion operator connecting all symmetries and Hamiltonian structures. This resolves the question affirmatively: SKdV_1 is bi-Hamiltonian.

status_evidence.title: Bi-Hamiltonian structure of the N=2 supersymmetric α=1 KdV hierarchy
status_evidence.snippet: constructed in explicit form ... bi-Hamiltonian structure as well as a recursion operator connecting all symmetries and Hamiltonian structures of the N=2 α=1 KdV hierarchy.
status_evidence.claim: A bi-Hamiltonian structure for SKdV_1 (N=2, α=1) is explicitly constructed.
